mutants.why: This is the shipped CLI binding defect found during WS3c-2: --new-size-bytes was parsed but commit-image-resize passed the current --size-bytes value, making every image resize current-to-current. test_sak_apfs_writer_cli grows a generated image by exactly one APFS block, asserts the exact larger size, shrinks it back, and asserts the original size; the mutant fails the grow command before any stale output can satisfy the size checks.
